evidence.method: Go AST string literals exactly equal to a catalog type; unknown types use the documented pattern. Comments are excluded.
evidence.limitation: local_predicate_declared records only a code literal location, not runtime reachability, detection behavior, completeness, or AWS conformance. no_local_predicate means no matching literal in the inspected files. Dynamically constructed type names are not inferred.
